ul.li: BIOS need to program the Stolen memory region ( DSM, GSM, PAVP, GGC) and BDF register in DE.
BIOS should initialize the supported CDCLK and Power well flow.

The following are display registers that BIOS (or other boot software or firmware) programs. Refer to the register definitions for offsets and fields.
BIOS can optionally read the ID to find the display version and stepping - DE_ID
Early BIOS programs memory range/base/size/limit to match graphics PCI registers and/or the settings used for 3D and media
DISMLIMIT_MSB, DISMLIMIT_LSB, DISMBASE_MSB, DISMBASE_LSB, DEGSMBASE, DEDSMBASE, DE Graphics Control, DE_GGC, FlatCCSBaseandRange (upper and lower Dwords), DE Protected Audio Video Path Control Register, DEPAVPC_REG

After other early BIOS programming, early BIOS programs SAI policy registers to remove BIOS from the WAC and then CP to lock itself out from further access
WAC_DEBIOSEARLY_MSB
WAC_DEBIOSEARLY_LSB
CP_DEBIOSEARLY_MSB
CP_DEBIOSEARLY_LSB (LSB last since it contains the BIOS bit)

BIOS programs BDF for display and KVM
DE_BDF = 0/2/0 for integrated graphics, 0/0/0 for discrete graphics
VDMBDFBARKVM = CSME BDF (integrated graphics only)

BIOS programs memory configuration info for display memory bandwidth calculations
MEM_SS_INFO_QGV_POINT_* = Qclk GV point configuration, register instance per-GV point
MEM_SS_INFO_GLOBAL = Global memory configuration

If CSE is updated to use sideband for KVMR messaging, program DG_CNTL_PROTECTED 134110h KVMR RAVDM Enable = 0 to have display use sideband, instead of RAVDMs, to message CSE. Above for Xe3 Display Important Replaced with Strap for Xe3p Display
No BIOS implications for Xe3p Display for NVL.

BIOS programs panel power to speed up internal panel bring up
NDE_RSTWRN_OPT RST PCH Handshake En = 1. This is required to allow reset prep to disable panel power gracefully.
PP_CONTROL = Vdd override (only if required for speedup of 1st panel power up)
PP_CONTROL_2 = Vdd override (only if required for speedup of 2nd panel power up)

BIOS programs PICA device ID based on the SoC device ID (only if requested as a workaround)
PICA_DEVICE_ID = ID from the Configurations section
BIOS configures SoC GPIO registers for audio (if there are cross-die IOs), hotplug, panel power and backlight, DDC, genlock, etc.
